name: Passport York
summary: Sign in and manage your account

details.title: Passport York
details.html:
Passport York authenticates you as a current member of the York computing community and gives you access to a wide range of computing resources and services. All new students are required to create a Passport York account

**Please note that your computing accounts will expire when you graduate. Please see the Account Lifecycle tab for more information

Passport York's fixed maintenance window is every Wednesday between 5:00 a.m. and 7:00 a.m. Services that might be unavailable during this time include all Student Record Services and Applications—REM, Manage My Services, AirYork, YorkNet, VPN, and Parking Services

Submit a Service Request

details.title: Accounts Lifecycle
details.html:
Your status as a student with the Registrar's Office drives the state of your computing accounts. Computing accounts, such as email, OneDrive, and MyApps, are created once you receive your student number and choose a Passport York username

Please see the tabs below (Active state, Expiring state, Cancelled state, Removed state) for more information about your computing services/accounts. Please pay special attention to the expiring state, as that is when you have your last opportunity to save any emails or files you may want to keep

As a reminder, your computer services/accounts have a lifecycle, but your Passport York account will remain available should you need to access your student records, transcripts, or continue your schooling
